item.title: Anthropic raises $81 bn, set to secure $1.8 trn valuation in Nasdaq debut
item.description: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, valuing the Claude maker at $1.5 trillion. Strong opening indications pointed to a potential $1.8 trillion valuation.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic was on course to secure a $1.8 trillion valuation when its shares start trading on Thursday, in a historic debut that pits promises of artificial intelligence (AI) as an economic game-changer against fears of a market bubble and risks to humanity. The stock was set to open at $99.82, about 20 per cent higher than the initial public offering (IPO) price of $83, according to indications as of 8:20 pm IST on Thursday. The Claude chatbot maker’s upsized IPO, together with Tuesday’s earnings report by AI poster child Nvidia, signals the industry has nominally passed the two big tests facing it this week. The strong demand for Anthropic shares amid a broader tech selloff offers hope to a sector where euphoria has somewhat cooled in recent weeks. AI technology has boosted economic growth, sparked doomsday warnings and arguably helped usher in a data-centre-sceptic Democratic tsunami in the US midterm elections. Investors who once embraced the boom have turned sceptical in recent weeks over concerns that the enormous spending needed to build out the sector and the mounting debt loads may not be justified by the eventual returns. Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in the largest stock-market debut on record after increasing the size of its offering, in a deal that values the Claude chatbot maker at $1.5 trillion and defied concerns over AI and tech fundraising. In a sign of strong investor demand, Anthropic priced its shares at $83 each, above its initial range of $70 to $78. Reuters was first to report on Wednesday that Anthropic, the first major frontier AI model developer to float, had increased the number of shares it was selling by about 19 per cent to 980 million. Anthropic’s IPO eclipses the debut of Elon Musk’s SpaceX in June. Its total deal size is $107.3 billion, including another $26 billion that Anthropic is raising through a private placement of shares, the filings showed. Nasdaq futures rose nearly 2 per cent on Thursday, bolstering expectations for a strong Anthropic debut and reviving sentiment around AI stocks. Chipmakers and cloud companies, which have raised hundreds of billions of dollars to fund their massive spending plans, have in recent weeks come under pressure due to valuation concerns, mounting AI infrastructure costs and the sudden exit of Nvidia’s Jensen Huang. Anthropic has, meanwhile, faced questions about its outlook and ability to sustain rapid growth as competition intensifies. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are lead underwriters for Anthropic’s IPO, which has a 22-bank underwriting syndicate. Anthropic’s annualised revenue run rate reached $81 billion as of October 31, up $10 billion from September 30, according to its IPO filing. Underscoring its growing business foothold, Anthropic said it had 11,900 customers generating at least $100,000 in annual revenue on a trailing 12-month basis as of September 30, compared with more than 1,500 at the end of last year. But to sustain that growth, Anthropic spent nearly $9 billion on computing capacity and infrastructure in the first half of 2026. Anthropic also incurred an additional $5 billion in computing costs in the third quarter, reducing the revenue generated per dollar of computing capacity. Revenue rose to $16.96 billion in the third quarter, up 47 per cent from the second. The company reported an operating loss of $567 million, compared with operating income of $974 million in the previous quarter. The net loss narrowed to $23.3 billion from $66.3 billion a quarter earlier, including non-operating items related to bonds convertible into its shares. Anthropic has committed to nearly $900 billion in computing spending with infrastructure partners, including Amazon and Alphabet’s Google, to train and operate AI models.

Nov 19 : Ubisoft expects net bookings of around 250 million euros ($274.1 million) for the third quarter, the French videogame maker's CFO Frederick Duguet said on Thursday. This reflects a lighter content release program than usual and a particularly competitive holiday season. • Ubisoft's second-quarter net bookings fell 20.8 per cent on the year to 388.9 million euros, but were above its guidance of around 370 million euros, helped by sales of "Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced" • The third phase of its cost-reduction program, targeting a fixed cost base of 1.25 billion euros on a run-rate basis by March 2028, was firmly on track, the company said as it confirmed its full-year targets • Ubisoft expects a "significantly" stronger and diversified content pipeline for fiscal 2027-28 and 2028-29, with releases across major brands

item.description:
Niket Nishant Manya Saini Echo Wang

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック上場、初値34％高の111.5ドル　時価総額一時2.1兆ドル 2:00 配信

19日、ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton（ロイター） Niket Nishant　Manya Saini　Echo Wang

[１９日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックが１９日、ナスダック市場に新規上場した。主要ＡＩ開発企業としては世界初の上場となり、時価総額は一時２兆１０００億ドルに達した。

初値は１１１．５ドルと、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）価格の８３ドルを約３４％上回った。直近の取引では１０５．１１ドル近辺で推移している。

ＩＰＯでは約８１０億ドルを調達し、６月に上場した米宇宙企業スペースＸの７５０億ドルを上回って過去最大のＩＰＯとなった。

主幹事証券会社が追加株式購入オプションを全額行使した場合、調達額は最大９３５億ドルに達する可能性がある。また、私募を通じて調達した２６０億ドルを含めると、調達総額は１０７０億ドルを超える。

規制当局への提出文書によると、ゴールドマン・サックスとモルガン・スタンレーが率いる引受団は、約５億５０００万ドルの手数料を得る見込み。

また、今回のＩＰＯにより、アンソロピックの現・元従業員の間で数千人の「ペーパーミリオネア（含み資産ベースの百万長者）」が誕生する見通しのほか、ＩＰＯ価格に基づくロイターの試算では、同社株式の約１０％を共同で保有するダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）ら共同創業者７人の保有株式の価値は１５００億ドル近くに達する。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：中国ユニツリー、上場後に株価急落　バブルやＩＰＯ制度に懸念 焦点：ＳＨＥＩＮの香港上場、ＥＳＧ問題がなお影　投資家の懸念根強く アングル：スペースＸ株が公開価格割れ、投資家の信頼守れるか　他案件に影響も アングル：スペースＸ株取引、上場1週目から熱狂的　個人投資家が殺到 アングル：ＡＩブームを巡る「熱狂」と「不安」　株高騰の一方で大量失業懸念も 11/20(金) 2:41 最終更新 ロイター

LONDON, Nov 19 : Elon Musk's SpaceXSI has filed its defence against a British lawmaker's lawsuit over fake images of her created using the Grok AI platform, arguing that obviously fictitious, AI-generated content cannot breach someone's right to privacy. Jess Asato, a member of Britain's governing Labour Party who has publicly criticised both Musk and Grok, is suing after users generated sexualised images of her, including a video of her "being chloroformed and prepared for a sexual assault". In its written defence, dated October 29, SpaceXSI, part of Musk's SpaceX, denies liability for any alleged breach of Asato's privacy or data protection rights. Asato filed her lawsuit at London's High Court for misuse of private information and breaches of data protection laws, alleging the way Grok was designed and trained enabled it to generate sexualised content.

The company's defence, in one of the first claims to test liability for the design of an AI system, could provide an insight into how designers may contest similar lawsuits. Lawyers for SpaceX Super Intelligence LLC said it had removed AI-generated images of Asato that breached its terms, including the video depicting Asato being chloroformed. They argued, however, that other images it allowed to remain available "would be understood by reasonable and sensible persons viewing that content to be AI-generated, fictitious and implausible ... rather than as realistic images", meaning Asato has no reasonable expectation of privacy. SpaceXSI also argues it did not breach Asato's data protection rights, including because it "did not determine the content of the relevant users' prompts". LAWMAKER SAYS PLATFORMS SHOULD BE ACCOUNTABLE Asato said in a statement on Thursday that those building powerful AI tools must take responsibility. "SpaceX SI wants to have it both ways," Asato said.  "The company admits it built the AI model, rewrote user requests to add its own graphic details, pulled images from across the internet, and published the results from an account it controls," she said, adding: "Yet it also claims it is a neutral bystander without legal responsibility". Asato is seeking a court order requiring SpaceXSI, which was formerly called xAI and then SpaceXAI, to "implement effective and permanent technical measures" to ensure Grok cannot create manipulated images of her. SpaceXSI says she is not entitled to such an order.  Grok, which is distributed through social media platform X, is subject to regulatory probes in several countries after an outcry over its use to create non-consensual sexualised images. In mid-January, xAI said it restricted image editing in Grok and blocked users from generating images of people in revealing clothing "where it's illegal".  But Reuters found in early February that, even after new curbs, Grok continued to generate sexualised images of people even when users explicitly warned the subjects did not consent. X and xAI did not address detailed questions from Reuters about Grok's generation of sexualised material. In July, xAI sued a man in the US alleging he misused Grok to create child sexual abuse material, in one of the first cases of its kind brought by an AI company.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 19 : Criminal duo Lucia and Jason's blitz through Vice City in "GTA VI" is set to help Take-Two Interactive — the publisher of the blockbuster game that is now a global cultural phenomenon — rake in nearly $2 billion in estimated first-day sales. Take-Two Interactive, the parent company of GTA developer Rockstar Games, is not a household name despite its portfolio of massive hits including the "Red Dead Redemption" franchise and the "NBA 2K" basketball series. Analytics firm Sensor Tower estimates total units sold at 19.1 million as of Thursday morning, translating to about $1.84 billion in revenue for Take-Two. That is more than twice the roughly $800 million worth of copies GTA V sold on its first day in 2013, widely regarded as the best-selling videogame in the first 24 hours. Meanwhile, Take-Two has remained tight-lipped about GTA VI demand since it opened for pre-orders in June, limiting commentary to saying demand has been "unprecedented" or "far exceeding expectations."

"The title is so widely anticipated, consumers appear very, very excited, and all the press so far has been universally positive, but we still aren't ready to declare victory," CEO Strauss Zelnick said on Take-Two's earnings call earlier this month. "We tend to avoid claiming success before it occurs." Take-Two shares were down about 1 per cent on Thursday after closing 6 per cent higher in the previous session. GTA VI MARKETING BLITZ Take-Two has shelled out an estimated $1 billion or more in production costs for GTA VI, making it one of the most expensive entertainment projects. Sensor Tower estimates that the game's promotional trailer, GTA VI "Extended Look", on Netflix in August helped drive a sixfold jump in pre-orders. In Miami — which Vice City is based on — the city's NBA team celebrated the release on Wednesday with a Vice City-themed match. Over the weekend, the company is hosting "GTA VI: The Festival" — a music show with a star-studded line-up that includes Grammy-winning rapper Cardi B, hip hop record producer Metro Boomin and rapper Travis Scott. WHAT NEXT FOR TAKE-TWO? Investors have been waiting to hear from Take-Two about its plans for a PC launch of GTA VI and an online version rollout. The online, multiplayer component of a videogame is crucial in turning the title into a recurring revenue engine. Some industry analysts are expecting the PC launch and online mode in 2027. Brokerage TD Cowen named Take-Two one of its 'Best Ideas' for 2027, with its analyst Doug Creutz upbeat about the company's financial prospects when the game releases online. "The potential ceiling for GTA VI's long-term recurrent consumer spending performance is very high ... 'when' and 'how big' the next GTA Online will be is the most important question for the stock, more so than GTA VI unit sales."

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK/LONDON, Nov 19 : Stocks fell across the world on Thursday as Anthropic's market debut kept trading choppy, while oil prices rose as traders focused on lingering attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Europe's tech stocks and the Nasdaq ebbed and flowed with focus squarely on the Claude developer's IPO. Priced at $83 apiece, valuing Anthropic at about $1.5 trillion, it is the first major AI developer to go public. How it trades in the coming days and weeks will be heavily scrutinized to gauge the broader sentiment towards AI. As of 1635 GMT, Anthropic shares had not yet traded. "We can't underestimate the importance of this IPO. It sort of serves as a valuation for the wider AI ecosystem," said Fiona Cincotta, senior market analyst at StoneX.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.97 per cent to 49,710.33, the S&P 500 fell 0.41 per cent to 7,293.42 and the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.16 points, or 0.01 per cent, to 24,431.04.  MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe fell 0.55 per cent to 1,068.62, and the pan-European STOXX 600 index fell 0.72 per cent. Emerging market stocks fell 1.28 per cent, while Japan's Nikkei rose 0.71 per cent to 59,444.21. The dollar index was steady after its recent rally to 19-month highs lost momentum. "Dollar bulls are going to need more conviction or more bullish news to drive dollar gains in the short run," Shaun Osborne, chief currency strategist at Scotiabank, said, pointing to a pickup in risk sentiment linked to Anthropic. The index was little changed at 103.81, with the euro up 0.06 per cent at $1.098. OIL EDGES UP In commodities, oil prices edged higher as renewed attacks in the Strait of Hormuz offset a growing view that the oil market will soon be back in surplus. Iran's navy said in a statement carried by state media that two oil tankers hit naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and "exploded" on Thursday. Reuters could not independently verify the report. US crude rose 1.25 per cent to $84.30 a barrel and Brent rose to $92.54 per barrel, up 0.64 per cent on the day. Spot gold fell 1.25 per cent to $3,675.99 an ounce, while spot silver fell 1.13 per cent to $44.51 an ounce.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 19 : Ahead of Anthropic's blockbuster market debut, brokerages including Needham and Melius Research started coverage of the AI firm with bullish recommendations, betting the company would emerge as the "real AI disruptor". Anthropic was on course to secure a $2 trillion valuation when its shares start trading on Thursday. The stock was set to open at $110.5, 33 per cent higher than the IPO price of $83 per share, according to indications as of 11.38 am ET. Feverish demand for Anthropic shares amid a broader tech selloff, underscores enduring investor appetite for pure AI plays after enthusiasm for the sector softened in recent weeks. "Anthropic maybe one of the few AI stocks that holds up in the near term, while the rest of the AI trade still faces questions," said Ben Reitzes, analyst at Melius Research, as he started coverage on the stock with a "buy" rating and a 24-month price target of $155.

Melius' target, the highest so far among analysts that have launched coverage, implies an upside of nearly 87 per cent from Anthropic's IPO price. "Growth opportunities like Anthropic rarely come along, but we think history puts Anthropic in the same dominant bucket as fellow tech titans Amazon, Google and Microsoft," Needham said, as it started coverage with a "buy" rating and a $150 price target. Anthropic has nearly $900 billion in computing commitments with partners including Amazon and Alphabet's Google. Both Melius and Citizens, which started coverage with a "market outperform" rating and a $125 price target, expect the firm's revenues to hit over $400 billion by 2029. A syndicate of more than 20 banks was involved in the IPO, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley working as the lead underwriters. item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１９日、訪中時に習近平国家主席と人工知能（ＡＩ）について協議したと明らかにした。

トランプ氏は米ＮＢＣに対し、「われわれは超知能（スーパーインテリジェンス、ＳＩ）について話し合い、ともに強い関心を持っている点で一致した」と説明。「われわれは、少なくとも最低限のガードレール（安全措置）を設けることが良いことだと考えている」と語った。

「最低限」とは具体的に何を意味するのかとの質問に対しては、「定義については踏み込まなかった」と応じた。

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 19 : Anthropic's IPO is having a blockbuster first day following the AI lab's record-setting fundraising. Shares opened more than 30 per cent above their offering price on Thursday at $111.50 a share, conferring a $2 trillion market value - a level exceeded by only a handful of US-listed firms. By reaching that level at the open on Thursday the firm outpaced rival SpaceX, whose value at its opening trade in June hit $1.96 trillion. The company on Wednesday evening priced its offering above range and increased the number of shares being sold, initially valuing the Claude chatbot maker at $1.5 trillion and defying concerns about the state of one of the pillars of the artificial intelligence boom. Shares across the AI sector were mixed as investors sift through worries about the impact of higher rates on a sector that took off during the era of easy money, an age that appears to have come to an end.

MARKET REACTION: US STOCKS: Major indexes were mixed after opening higher, with the Nasdaq <.IXIC> up 0.1 per cent  after rising as much as 2 per cent after the open and the S&P 500 down 0.4 per cent after earlier rising nearly 1 per cent. BONDS: US Treasury yields were little changed, with the 2-year yield flat at 4.8 per cent and the 10-year yield flat at 5.066 per cent. FOREX: The dollar index was off 0.03 per cent at 103.79. COMMENTS: TONY, TRZCINKA, SENIOR PORTFOLIO MANAGER, IMPAX ASSET MANAGEMENT, BOSTON: "The market  is looking through this strong IPO.  It doesn’t settle the concerns driving the de-rating of the trade due to changes at Nvidia, (Democratic) blue wave and sentiment in Washington DC."  MICHAEL ROSEN, CIO, ANGELES INVESTMENTS, SANTA MONICA, CALIFORNIA: “The ANT IPO saw strong demand, giving a near-term boost to sentiment in the AI ecosystem. But it doesn’t change some of the fundamental challenges that have arisen with the departure of Jensen Huang at Nvidia or the political pushback on data center, and AI in general, development.“Demand for computing power remains strong, so this is not an industry in imminent collapse, but there is a realignment of marginal winners and losers among investors, and those with existing computing power in a stronger position than those without. So hyperscalers, with strong balance sheets and cash flows may be better positioned than those more exposed to the pure growth of data center buildout.“We continue to emphasize to investors that historically disruptive technological advances favor those companies that can harness the new technology to create new products and services over those that supply the new technology. Some of those beneficiaries will be existing companies that are most adaptable, but many will be entirely new companies that are being started now or are yet to be born. Investors should alter their investment approach to align with the theme of successfully adapting to this disruptive technology.” TALLEY LEGER, CHIEF MARKET STRATEGIST, WEALTH CONSULTING GROUP, KEYPORT, NEW JERSEY: “While Anthropic represents top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure with massive revenue momentum, it isn't a prudent 'buy-at-any-price' opportunity for retail wealth clients . . . We like the enterprise AI narrative, but we do not like overpaying for market sentiment. Patience is a strategy. Let the initial volatility settle, the lock-up period expire, and the company deliver 2–3 quarters of public reporting before establishing a position. . . History shows that retail investors buying hot tech IPOs on day one historically underperform broad market indexes over a 3-year horizon once the initial pop fades.” SHAWN SNYDER, ECONOMIC STRATEGIST, POTOMAC FUND MANAGEMENT, BETHESDA, MARYLAND: “Anthropic’s IPO could provide a much-needed boost to sentiment across the AI ecosystem, as the offering is certainly generating considerable excitement among investors. However, enthusiasm for AI is increasingly competing with concerns about the rising cost of capital, particularly as some Federal Reserve policymakers are discussing the possibility of a 50-basis-point rate hike in December. A successful debut could lift sentiment, though sustaining that enthusiasm may be more difficult.“Over the next 6–12 months, the one indicator we would watch is AI stock market breadth relative to the broader technology sector. The volatility around AI is still frequently described as investor jitters rather than outright fear. In our view, the first sign that AI enthusiasm has peaked may not be a slowdown in AI spending, but the moment investors stop rewarding companies simply for being associated with AI.” MARK HACKETT, CHIEF MARKET STRATEGIST, NATIONWIDE FINANCIAL, PHILADELPHIA: “Sentiment and positioning have shifted at a tremendous pace for the AI trade. It is no surprise that Anthropic is highly anticipated, as it is a leader, where the skepticism is more around the more speculative and risky crowd. How the AI space trades today will show if investors are committing new capital or simply reallocating funds from elsewhere. Strength among the competitors and complements would be an encouraging sign that the selloff is near the end, but weakness would tell a different story.” GIL LURIA, HEAD OF TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH, D.A. DAVIDSON, PORTLAND, OREGON: "Anthropic’s IPO is pivotal for the AI investment cycle. A successful IPO could extend the cycle by years and an unsuccessful IPO could stall investment. Indication that the IPO is shaping up well would be very positive for other AI-related stocks." JOE ZIDLE, CHIEF MARKET STRATEGIST, CRESSET, NEW YORK: “Landmark IPOs tend to mark turning points in sentiment, so I interpret the success of ANT as an endorsement of the road ahead. Public investors are paying up, and that tells you that the debate has moved from ‘Is this real?’ to ‘Who captures the value?’ That’s a far healthier conversation for the whole AI ecosystem.”

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米英仏独、イランに核施設の査察受け入れ要求 ＩＡＥＡ理事会で共同声明
item.description:
Francois Murphy
[ウィーン １９日 ロイター] - 米英仏独の４カ国は１９日、国際原子力機関（ＩＡＥＡ）の理事会で、イランに対し、米国とイスラエルにより昨年爆撃された核施設への査察官の立ち入りを許可するよう強く求めた。また、イランが「妨害行為」を行っていると批判した。
４カ国は、ＩＡＥＡの３５カ国からなる理事会への共同声明で「１年半にわたり、これまで検証済みであったイランの高濃縮ウランの備蓄に関する情報の継続性が失われていることは、理事会の全加盟国にとって懸念されるべき事態である」と表明。「（グロッシ）事務局長は、現時点で、ＩＡＥＡが攻撃を受けた核施設に立ち入るのを妨げる技術的な理由はなく、査察官らは既に長期間にわたり、現地に戻る準備が整っていると繰り返し明確にしてきた」と指摘した。
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Francois Murphy

[ウィーン　１９日　ロイター] - 米英仏独の４カ国は１９日、国際原子力機関（ＩＡＥＡ）の理事会で、イランに対し、米国とイスラエルにより昨年爆撃された核施設への査察官の立ち入りを許可するよう強く求めた。また、イランが「妨害行為」を行っていると批判した。

４カ国は、ＩＡＥＡの３５カ国からなる理事会への共同声明で「１年半にわたり、これまで検証済みであったイランの高濃縮ウランの備蓄に関する情報の継続性が失われていることは、理事会の全加盟国にとって懸念されるべき事態である」と表明。「（グロッシ）事務局長は、現時点で、ＩＡＥＡが攻撃を受けた核施設に立ち入るのを妨げる技術的な理由はなく、査察官らは既に長期間にわたり、現地に戻る準備が整っていると繰り返し明確にしてきた」と指摘した。

さらにイランの「妨害戦略」に言及した上で、「この機会を捉え、方針を転換し、核開発計画を巡る国際社会の長年の懸念に対処できるかはイラン次第だ」と述べた。

イランは２０２５年６月のこれら核施設に対する攻撃以降、ＩＡＥＡによる立ち入りを許可していない。

空爆により、当時稼働が確認されていたイランのウラン濃縮施設３カ所は破壊または甚大な損傷を受けたものの、イラン当局は兵器級に近い物質を含む高濃縮ウランの備蓄の行方を明らかにしておらず、その所在は依然として不明なままだ。

FAST

Nov 19 : The Union of Arab Football Associations (UAFA) said on Thursday it backed Gianni Infantino's candidacy for another term as FIFA president. • UAFA said in a statement its endorsement recognised Infantino's efforts and contributions to the development and growth of football during his tenure • The organisation said those efforts, along with the work of FIFA's leadership, had contributed to the continued development of football worldwide • The election will take place in March 2027, with Infantino set to face challengers for the first time after being re-elected unopposed in 2019 and 2023

• FIFA said on Thursday that Infantino would face challengers Philippe Diallo, president of the French Football Federation, and Kozo Tashima, honorary president of the Japan Football Association • Infantino has faced repeated calls to resign since the collapse of his FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal, which sought private investment in a new entity controlling commercial rights linked to major FIFA competitions, including the World Cup • UAFA, founded in 1974, represents 22 national football associations across Africa and Asia, and its backing gives Infantino the endorsement of an established regional body • Infantino gave his best wishes to the candidates, saying in a statement that the election was a celebration of the sport's democratic values • "Let this be an electoral period of positive ideas - for the betterment of our global game - carried out with honour, respect and in the spirit of fair play which our game stands for," Infantino said (Reporting By Ahmed Abd Ellatif in Cairo and Rohith Nair in Bengaluru;Editing by Toby Davis)

item.title: トランプ氏、東南アジアで米企業向け170億ドル超の案件 ボーイング機受注など
item.description: [クアラルンプール １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[クアラルンプール １９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領はアジア歴訪後、東南アジアにおける米企業向けの取引や戦略的投資として、総額１７０億ドル超の案件を発表した。

ホワイトハウスによると、米航空機大手ボーイングと航空機エンジン大手ＧＥエアロスペースによる、フィリピン航空へのボーイング７８７型機２０機の売却（１２０億ドル規模）が含まれる。

さらに、フィリピンの防衛装備購入に向けて、米国は２０億ドル超の資金調達を支援するほか、南シナ海での軍事作戦支援のため４億ドルを提供する。

タイは、米国製の高機動ロケット砲システム「ハイマース（ＨＩＭＡＲＳ）」の導入に最大１億２３００万ドルを投じる計画。実現すれば、東南アジアで初のハイマース取引となる可能性がある。

また、インドネシアでは、米国の技術を活用した２０億ドル規模の石炭プロジェクトについて交渉が進められているほか、マレーシア国営電力会社の子会社向けに石炭を供給する３年間で総額１億ドル規模の契約が締結された。

このほか米国は、マレーシアとブルネイにおける人工知能（ＡＩ）開発プログラムへの支援を約束したという。

FAST

TURIN, Nov 19 : World number four Ben Shelton had to battle for over two hours before carving out a 7-6(8) 7-5 win over Spaniard Rafael Jodar at the ATP Finals on Thursday to close in on a last four spot. The US Open finalist must wait for the result of the other group match later on Thursday between world number one Alexander Zverev, who has already made the semi-finals, and France's Arthur Fils. The American, a Paris Masters finalist earlier this month, looked in trouble when he struggled with Jodar's serve and did not muster a break point in the first set. It was Jodar who looked more likely to break the deadlock before Shelton got the edge in a tightly contested tiebreak.

Shelton, however, stayed composed and won two long and brutal baseline rallies to break back before delivering a near-perfect service game to seal his win. The 20-year-old Jodar, who has enjoyed a sensational debut year on the tour shooting up from the mid-100s to the top 10 in less than 12 months, will end his debut ATP Finals appearance with three group losses.

item.title: ＪＰモルガン、委託先がサイバー攻撃の標的に 一部顧客情報流出の可能性
item.description:
Nupur Anand
[１９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nupur Anand

[１９日 ロイター] - 米金融大手ＪＰモルガン・チェースは１９日、同社にサービスを提供している委託先企業がサイバー攻撃の標的になったと明らかにした。

同社の広報担当者は「これまでの調査に基づくと、攻撃者はこれらのベンダーが保有する特定のマーケティングデータにアクセスしたとみられ、その中には一部の顧客の氏名やメールアドレスが含まれている可能性がある」と述べ、影響を受けた顧客には直接連絡を取ると説明した。その上で、「今週初めに発生したサービス障害との関連はない」と述べた。

米国ではこのところシステム障害が相次いでおり、先週には連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）が航空管制センターの通信障害を受けて、全米で航空機の離陸停止を指示したほか、マイクロソフトの業務ソフト「マイクロソフト３６５」で発生した大規模障害により、サービスが１日以上停止した。

Nov 19 : Palo Alto Networks shares gained more than 6 per cent on Thursday as its higher annual forecast lifted cybersecurity stocks, with investors betting companies would spend big on defending against sophisticated AI-enabled cyberattacks. If the gains hold, Palo Alto would add more than $18 billion to its market value. Investor interest in cybersecurity firms has grown as AI reshapes the cyber arms race — the technology helps attackers uncover and exploit vulnerabilities faster, while increasing demand for software that can identify, block and respond to emerging threats before they multiply. Those concerns have been reinforced by a series of recent technology outages and vulnerabilities identified in Java and PHP, two programming languages underpinning millions of business applications and websites.

"As companies accelerate AI adoption, cybersecurity is becoming an increasingly mission-critical, non-discretionary investment," said Ivan Feinseth, director of research at Tigress Financial Partners. At least 20 brokerages raised their price targets on Palo Alto after its earnings report, giving it a median price target of $425, according to data compiled by LSEG. The upbeat forecast from the company, which also announced a $4.5 billion acquisition of AI startup Applied Compute on Wednesday, boosted sentiment across the cybersecurity sector. Shares of CrowdStrike, Zscaler and Fortinet climbed between 2 per cent and 9 per cent, while Okta, Cloudflare, F5 and SentinelOne gained 1 per cent to 10 per cent each, extending the sector's rally. Technology stocks were also rising ahead of Anthropic's market debut later on Thursday. The Claude maker priced the largest initial public offering on record above its marketed range, helping lift the Nasdaq composite about 2 per cent and reviving appetite for beaten-down AI-linked stocks.

item.description: WASHINGTON, Nov 19 : NASA confirmed on Thursday that its Voyager 1 probe has achieved an unprecedented distance milestone — the first spacecraft to travel beyond a light-day from Earth — while flying into an uncertain future in interstellar space.The US space agency said it received a radio signal from th

NASA confirms Voyager 1 probe's 'light-day' distance milestone

An artist's concept depicts NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft entering interstellar space, in this image was released on September 12, 2013. NASA/JPL-Caltech/Handout via REUTERS

19 Nov 2026 11:16PM (Updated: 19 Nov 2026 11:37PM)

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 19 : NASA confirmed on Thursday that its Voyager 1 probe has achieved an unprecedented distance milestone — the first spacecraft to travel beyond a light-day from Earth — while flying into an uncertain future in interstellar space. The US space agency said it received a radio signal from the robotic explorer, launched in 1977, indicating that it passed the distance that light travels in 24 hours — about 16 billion miles (26 billion km) — as expected on Wednesday at 5:16 a.m. EST (1016 GMT). Voyager 1 is the most distant human-made object. NASA waited a day to make the official announcement because it took about that long for the spacecraft's signal to reach Earth. "Traveling a light-day is a singular feat for a spacecraft, but Voyager is so much more than a distant traveler. The Voyager mission would be remarkable just for what it contributed to planetary science with the Grand Tour of the outer planets," Joe Westlake, director of NASA's heliophysics division, said in a statement released by the agency.

"But it went on to become central to NASA's fleet of heliophysics missions offering insights into the star that we all revolve around, the sun," Westlake said. Voyager 1 journeyed past Jupiter and Saturn, the solar system's two largest planets, earlier in its mission. It continues to gather scientific data. Voyager 1 is flying at almost 38,000 miles per hour (61,000 kph). It crossed the outer edge of the heliosphere, a protective bubble of particles and magnetic fields produced by the sun, to enter interstellar space in 2012. Its twin, Voyager 2, was also launched in 1977 and entered interstellar space in 2018. A representative at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory said this week that recent power-saving measures could give the two Voyager spacecraft enough power to stay in communication with Earth for three to four more years. Voyager 1 is still collecting data in the near-vacuum of interstellar space on effects from the sun such as solar storms that cause shocks and pressure fronts that extend as far away as the probe's current location. The 50th anniversary of its launch is next year.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＪＰモルガン、ＦＲＢの3会合連続利上げを予想 インフレ高止まり
item.description: [１９日 ロイター] - 米金融大手ＪＰモルガン・チェースは１９日、根強いインフレの継続で一段の金融引き締めが必要であ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＪＰモルガン、ＦＲＢの3会合連続利上げを予想　インフレ高止まり 0:01 配信

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）ビル。2025年9月17日撮影。REUTERS/Ken Cedeno（ロイター） [１９日 ロイター] - 米金融大手ＪＰモルガン・チェースは１９日、根強いインフレの継続で一段の金融引き締めが必要であるとの見方から、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が従来予想していた１２月の利上げに加え、来年１月と３月にも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施すると予想していると述べた。

マイケル・フェロリ氏率いるＪＰモルガンのストラテジストらは「これらの利上げは、労働市場を悪化させるものではなく、利上げの一時停止を正当化する説得力のある説明がない状況下で、ＦＲＢの信認を維持するためのものだ」と述べた。

また、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が金融政策の道筋に「包括的なナラティブ（物語）」がない状態にしていると指摘。「指針となるナラティブがなければ、政策は入ってくるデータに反応しやすくなる」との見方を示した。

さらに「労働市場はインフレ圧力の要因にはなってこなかったものの、それでもインフレは依然高止まりしている」と述べ、来年は緩やかながらもプラスの雇用増が見込まれるとの見通しを示した。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場は１２月の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での２５ｂｐの利上げはほぼ確実と見込んでおり、８％の確率で５０ｂｐの利上げが実施されるとの見方を織り込んでいる。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：米10年債利回り、利上げ局面でどこまで上昇　6％到達も視野 アングル：ＪＰモルガン、時価総額1兆ドルの大台が目前 アングル：実を結ぶＪＰモルガン独自戦略、スタートアップを初期段階から全力支援 11/20(金) 0:01 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ＡＩ投資がインフレ押し上げ、生産性効果は「まだ先」＝ＦＲＢ副議長
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のジェファーソン副...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ投資がインフレ押し上げ、生産性効果は「まだ先」＝ＦＲＢ副議長 11/19 23:59 配信

2026年7月16日、米国カリフォルニア州スタンフォードで撮影。 REUTERS/Ann Saphir/File Photo（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のジェファーソン副議長は１９日、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資の急拡大が需要への影響を通じて米国のインフレに上昇圧力をかけていると述べた。物価圧力の緩和につながり得る生産性向上は「将来」になってようやく現れるとの見方を示した。

ジェファーソン氏はブラジル中央銀行の会議に向けた講演原稿の中で、ＡＩブームは需要と供給の両方に影響を及ぼし得る種類のショックだが、その影響が及ぶ時期は異なると指摘した。

同氏は「需要面では、この技術への楽観がデータセンターや先進的なコンピューター機器、関連製品への企業投資を押し上げている」とし、「現在、ＡＩ投資は需要とインフレに上昇圧力をかけている」と述べた。

新技術による生産性の向上は物価に下押し圧力をかけ得るが、それは「将来」のことだとし、時期については明言しなかった。

ジェファーソン氏は講演原稿の中で、現在の金利見通しには言及しなかった。

item.title: 日米首脳が電話会談、「米中ロの詳細な説明あった」と高市氏
item.description:
Tamiyuki Kihara
[東京 １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相は１９日夜、首相公邸で米国のトランプ大統領と約２０分、電話で会談した。その後、記者団の取材に応じた高市氏は、中国・深センで開かれた米中首脳会談や米中ロ首脳会談の内容についてトランプ氏から詳細な説明があったと明らかにし、日米関係を一層強化していく考えを改めて示した。

トランプ氏は米大統領専用機エアフォース・ワンから電話会談に応じたという。高市氏は、インド太平洋情勢やウクライナ情勢を含む国際社会の諸課題について率直に意見交換したと説明。「いまや最も信頼し合える同盟国である日米の関係をさらなる高みに引き上げていく」と語った。米中や米中ロ首脳会談について具体的にどのような説明があったかは明らかにしなかった。

米中ロ首脳が合意した「平和宣言」に、国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）をけん制する文言が盛り込まれたことについては、「我が国としては（ＩＣＣを）一貫して支持をしてきている」とし、「これは日米で考え方が異なっていることではあるが、茂木（敏充・外務）大臣とルビオ（米）国務長官との間で意思疎通は継続している」とした。

高市氏は「引き続き関係国と協力しながら法の支配を強化していくというのが日本の立場だ。日本の立場は私からトランプ大統領にも伝えており、お分かりだと思う」と述べた。

（鬼原民幸　編集：久保信博）

LISBON, Nov 19 : The burgeoning six-a-side Baller League said on Thursday that it will launch in 2027 its own Nations Cup tournament spanning 64 cities and 16 countries with $1 million each for the winning men's and women's teams. "We believe it is the biggest prize ever put up for amateur footballers,” Baller League CEO Felix Starck said in a statement. Founded in 2024 in Germany and now with leagues in the UK and the US, the Baller League offers audiences a glitzier, shorter and cheaper version of watching the so-called "Beautiful Game" compared to traditional 90-minute soccer. “Football is pricing out the people who made it. A ticket to the World Cup cost thousands of dollars,” said Starck, stressing how any team could aspire to win its Nations Cup.

The tournament runs from June 26 to November 7 with 16 national champions competing in the final weekend at a host city to be announced.  “We don’t want people’s money to compete in this,” Starck, a German entrepreneur who founded the Baller League with backing from professional footballers, told Reuters. Baller League is backed by investors such as EQT Ventures, and recently wrapped up its inaugural season in the US.

item.title: プーチン氏、欧州特使にモスクワ訪問提案 ウクライナ協議での立場明確化求める
item.description: [モスクワ １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ １９日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は１９日、今後のウクライナ和平協議の形式を決める前に、欧州の特使らにモスクワを訪れて交渉に関する立場を明確にするよう提案したと明らかにした。

中国での米中首脳との会談終了後に発言した。プーチン氏は、これまで和平交渉は主にロシア、米国、ウクライナとの間で進められてきたが、ほとんど進展が見られておらず、米国はロシアに対して、欧州の交渉参加に同意するよう「かなり執拗に」働きかけていると述べた。

さらに、「欧州抜きで、欧州の安全保障を含む安全保障問題を議論するのは無意味だとわれわれは理解している」と指摘。その上で、「（欧州の参加に）反対しているわけではないが、欧州がこの交渉に何をもたらすのかを理解する必要がある。外交ルートを通じて、欧州の代表がモスクワを訪れ、彼らの立場を把握できるようにすることを提案した。その後、ウクライナとの対話をどのような形式で継続するかを決定するつもりだ」 と述べた。

欧州の関与は、約５年に及ぶ紛争の終結に向けた取り組みで新たな段階となる。トランプ米大統領は和平合意の成立を目指してきたが、実現には至っていない。

RedBird's Cardinale says NBA will make European basketball profitable

FAST

Nov 19 : RedBird Capital Partners managing partner Gerry Cardinale said on Wednesday that the NBA's proposed European league could transform the financial prospects of basketball on the continent. The NBA Europe project and a rival Euroleague expansion plan are both targeting a 2027 launch, putting the two competitions on a potential collision course. Cardinale, a prospective NBA Europe franchise owner, said the NBA could succeed where the established Euroleague had struggled financially. "The Euroleague hasn’t been able to fund itself over 26 years," Cardinale told the Sports Business Journal Dealmakers Conference.

"It’s this fascinating confluence of longevity, brand and fan base, and yet the financial fundamentals haven’t kept pace with that." EUROLEAGUE POINTS TO REVENUE GROWTH Euroleague CFO Xavi Puyada said it had "consistently increased its revenues season after season, achieving fivefold growth in commercial revenues over the past decade. "Currently, 40 per cent of our licensed clubs are financially sustainable, and EuroLeague Basketball projects that all licensed clubs will achieve financial sustainability by the end of the first phase of its 10-year business plan," Puyada added. RedBird launched holding company Milan Sports and Entertainment on Friday, which will explore the possibility of acquiring a Milan-based basketball franchise. "My bet, and the reason why I’ve gotten behind this, is I bet on the NBA to change that (the financial prospects of European basketball)," said Cardinale. "I totally agree with Mark (Tatum, NBA Deputy Commissioner). I cannot imagine a more interesting in-the-money option in sports globally than NBA Europe." Tatum, who appeared alongside Cardinale on the panel, said the NBA remained on schedule to launch the competition in 2027. Cardinale said the strength of European clubs’ ties to their supporters and local communities underpinned his confidence in the project. "The role of the fans and these teams in their communities is something that eclipses what we know in America," he said. "That’s very exciting. It’s totally income-inelastic. It is part of the fabric of the community." RedBird is also the majority shareholder in football club AC Milan. Tatum said a basketball game between an AC Milan team and Real Madrid would have global appeal that NBA Europe could capitalise on. British broadcaster Sky News reported on Monday that the NBA was discussing an investment in an infrastructure fund for European basketball. Tatum said NBA Europe team owners would be responsible for providing suitable arenas, although the league would support them in that process.

Source: Reuters

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 19 : The rapid artificial intelligence buildout is putting upward pressure on US inflation through its impact on demand, Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said on Thursday, with possible productivity gains that could help ease price pressures only coming "in the future." In prepared remarks to a Brazilian central bank conference, Jefferson said the AI boom is the sort of shock that could influence both demand and supply, but at different points in time. "On the demand side, optimism about the technology has been boosting business investment in data centers, advanced computing equipment, and related products," Jefferson said. "Currently, the AI buildout is exerting upward pressure on demand and inflation." Productivity improvements from the new technology could put downward pressure on prices, but only "in the future," Jefferson said, without estimating a timeline. Jefferson's prepared remarks did not mention his current interest-rate outlook. The Fed is expected to raise its policy rate by a quarter of a percentage point from the current range of 3.75 per cent-4.00 per cent at its December 8-9 policy meeting.

Source: Reuters

FAST

BANGKOK, Nov 19 : FIFA chief Gianni Infantino handed out trophies at the Asian Football Confederation annual awards on Thursday, including to Iran goalkeeper Alireza Beiranvand as AFC Player of the Year, hours after he was confirmed as running for reelection. The 56-year-old Infantino will face a challenge from French Football Federation boss Philippe Diallo and Japan Football Association Honorary President - and FIFA Council member - Kozo Tashima for the FIFA presidency in Rabat on March 18. Infantino was widely criticised over his FIFA Forward Enterprise proposal to bring private investment into a new entity controlling commercial rights linked to major FIFA competitions, including the World Cup. He subsequently abandoned the project and apologised over the way it was handled at a closed FIFA Council meeting.

The Swiss met a number of global soccer's powerbrokers at the awards in Thailand, including AFC President Sheikh Salman. Beiranvand received his trophy from Infantino and Sheikh Salman. North Korea's Kim Kyong Yong won the women's award. FIRST KEEPER HONOURED The 34-year-old Beiranvand is the first keeper to win the trophy since it was introduced in 1994 and the fifth Iranian named the continent's best player, following Khodadad Azizi, Ali Daei, Mehdi Mahdavikia and Ali Karimi. He was recognised for his performances at club level with Tractor FC and for the national team. "Receiving this award is an incredibly historic, unforgettable and emotional moment in my life," said Beiranvand.  "But above all I feel an immense sense of happiness and pride in representing my country. I do not see this award as an individual achievement. It is an honour that belongs to the people of Iran." Beiranvand won the men's award ahead of Saudi Arabian duo Feras Al-Brikan and Salem Al-Dawsari and was recognised for his performances at the World Cup, where Iran narrowly missed out on a place in the knockout rounds. Kim became the second player from North Korea to win the women's award after being recognised for her performances in Naegohyang FC's title-winning campaign in the Asian Women's Champions League. "Now that I have got this award, my dream has come true," she said.  Go Kuroda was named men's coach of the year after steering Japan's Machida Zelvia to the Asian Champions League Elite final, where they lost to the Matthias Jaissle-coached Al-Ahli of Saudi Arabia. Iran's Marziyeh Jafari retained the women's coaching award for her work with Bam Khatoon in the Asian Women's Champions League. South Korea's Lee Kang-in was the men's International Player of the Year after featuring for Paris Saint-Germain in their Champions League triumph this year, while Australia's Caitlin Foord won the women's award, having claimed the Champions Cup with Arsenal.

Source: Reuters

item.description: [ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１９日発表した１１月１４日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新規失業保険申請1000件増の20.3万件、労働市場なお安定 11/19 23:15 配信

2025年8月1日、米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスのターゲットに掲げられた求人看板。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１９日発表した１１月１４日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比１０００件増の２０万３０００件となった。小幅増加したものの、労働市場が依然として安定していることを示唆した。ただ、新たな職探しに苦戦している一部の失業者もいる。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は１９万７０００件だった。申請件数は９月中旬以降、２０万件前後で推移していた。

ネイビー・フェデラル・クレジット・ユニオンのチーフエコノミスト、ヘザー・ロング氏は「現在の雇用市場は『中程度の採用・低水準の解雇』の状態だ」と指摘。「キャリアを築こうとする若年層にとっては状況は依然厳しいが、１年前よりは容易になっている」と述べた。

エコノミストらは、底堅い国内需要を背景とした企業業績の堅調な伸びと、退職の増加やトランプ政権による移民取り締まりを背景とした労働力人口の縮小が、労働者を解雇から守っていると指摘している。

申請件数は、カリフォルニア州やテキサス州を含む４州で１０００件を超えて減少した一方、ミシガン州では６０９５件急増した。週ごとの変動をならした４週移動平均は２０００件増の１９万７７５０件となった。

１０月の失業期間の中央値は１１．９週間と、９月の１１．５週間から伸び、２０２１年１１月以来の高水準となった。

今回の申請件数データは、１１月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっている。

１１月７日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は７万件増の１７６万３０００件だった。この継続受給件数の急増は、職を失った一部の人が長期の失業に直面していることを示唆している。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：協調介入の米関与は限定的の受け止め、円再び160円台に　安値試しも 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 11/20(金) 1:26 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

Nov 19 : Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin said on Thursday that Alphabet's Google had selected its New Glenn rocket to launch satellites for Project Suncatcher, an experiment aimed at running AI systems in space. The planned mission advances efforts to move power-hungry AI computing beyond Earth, using sunlight in orbit to ease pressure on electricity grids, land and cooling systems. Companies including Elon Musk's SpaceX and startup Starcloud are exploring data centers in orbit as growing AI use drives demand for computing capacity and strains infrastructure supporting facilities on the ground. The launch, targeted for the first quarter of 2029, will be Google's first heavy-lift flight dedicated to Project Suncatcher and will carry several computing satellites aboard New Glenn.

Each satellite will carry Google's tensor processing units, the search giant's in-house chips built to run AI programs, with computing capacity roughly equal to a rack of servers in a conventional data center. They will enter an orbit that provides near-continuous sunlight, allowing Google to examine whether solar energy can support intensive computing in space. Thursday's agreement gives Blue Origin a major future mission for New Glenn as the company seeks to expand its launch business following delays and a launchpad explosion in May. Google and Planet Labs launched the first Project Suncatcher prototype aboard a SpaceX rocket in October and said the satellite was operating as expected after establishing contact. That mission is testing whether the chips can withstand launch forces, radiation and extreme temperatures, while engineers study how to cool them without the airflow available on Earth. Radiation can damage electronics and corrupt data, while heat from powerful chips must be released through pipes and panels rather than conventional cooling systems. Experts have also noted that high launch costs, engineering hurdles and limited satellite production can put data centers in orbit years away from commercial use.

Source: Reuters

Violence rises in Bangladesh as Hasina supporters escalate protests, PM Rahman blames India

Reuters

19 November, 2026 07:30 pm IST

Follow Us:

By Zia Chowdhury and Hritam Mukherjee DHAKA, Nov 19 (Reuters) – Fresh violence broke out in Bangladesh on Thursday as former prime minister Sheikh Hasina’s supporters tried to bring businesses and public transport to a halt, with mixed success, and Prime Minister Tarique Rahman blamed India for the unrest.

Unrelated protests by garment workers demanding higher wages also continued in some districts, with hundreds of workers blocking a highway into the capital Dhaka, forcing factories to close.

The rising unrest in the Muslim-majority nation of 175 million people — the world’s second-biggest garment exporter after China — threatens the fragile stability established since elections this year brought Rahman, a political opponent of Hasina’s outlawed Awami League, to power.

Show Full Article

Tensions have risen since Hasina, who fled after a student uprising against her rule in August 2024 and lives in exile in India, said she planned to return in December.

The Awami League called Thursday’s nationwide lockdown at the end of a week-long campaign of protests and rallies against the government’s rejection of her request for a new passport that would allow her to return. The attempted shutdown was successful mostly in the southern districts where the League is strongest.

Rahman’s government has accused Awami League leaders outside Bangladesh of fanning the violence and vowed action. Awami League leaders, most of them in hiding, could not be reached for comment.

PM RAHMAN POINTS FINGER AT ‘COUNTRY ACROSS BORDER’

At a public event in the northern district of Lalmonirhat, Rahman said Awami League leaders “have not looked at the interests of Bangladesh and its people”.

“At the same time, the country across the border, where they have fled to, is their master … To satisfy those masters, they have again started conspiring against Bangladesh, and its people,” he said, without naming India.

The Indian foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

After Hasina was ousted, relations with India deteriorated sharply under the interim government of Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus in Dhaka.

Ties have improved slightly since Rahman took office in February, although tensions over Hasina’s continued presence in India remain a major irritant.

Police said two members of the ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party had been killed on Wednesday night, while the houses of two BNP lawmakers in Hasina’s home district of Gopalganj were vandalised and set alight.

Awami League supporters also attacked some markets and vandalised some shops in Gopalganj town, they said.

At least six buses and pickup vans were set on fire along with a section of railway line, and crude bomb blasts were reported across six districts overnight. A bus and a truck were set on fire on Thursday on the Dhaka-Chattogram highway, police said, adding that the bus passengers had escaped unharmed.

YUNUS’ HOME SET ABLAZE

To deter violence, 97 platoons of the paramilitary Border Guard Bangladesh have fanned out across seven districts, including Gopalganj and Faridpur, considered to have many Hasina supporters, a Guard spokesperson said.

In Dhaka, police arrested 107 people suspected of links to the Awami League and its affiliated organisations in the space of 24 hours, including former education minister Nurul Islam Nahid, police said.

Yunus’ ancestral home in the port city of Chattogram, about 300 km (185 miles) southeast of Dhaka, was set on fire late on Wednesday.

It was likely that flammable substances had been thrown into an unused ground-floor room, police officer Mozammel Haque said. He said Yunus’ paternal family members, who live on the upper floors, were safe.

Reuters could not immediately reach the Yunus Centre think tank, which speaks on his behalf.

(Reporting by Zia Chowdhury in Dhaka; Additional reporting by Hritam Mukherjee; Writing by Tanvi Mehta and YP Rajesh; Editing by Clarence Fernandez, Sharon Singleton and Editing by Kevin Liffey)

Explainer-Rohingya crisis remains unresolved as ICJ rules on Myanmar

Reuters

19 November, 2026 07:00 pm IST

Follow Us:

Email

Nov 19 (Reuters) – A long-awaited judgment from the UN’s highest court on Thursday said that killings, destruction of homes and widespread sexual violence by Myanmar’s security forces amounted to state-sponsored genocide of the Rohingya Muslim minority population.

The decision comes nearly a decade after a 2017 military crackdown drove more than 730,000 Rohingya into Bangladesh, and as conflict, shrinking humanitarian aid and dangerous sea crossings continue to leave many members of the community displaced and vulnerable.

WHY DID THE ROHINGYA FLEE MYANMAR?

Show Full Article

More than 1.3 million Rohingya remain displaced across South and Southeast Asia, including 1.2 million in sprawling refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar in Bangladesh, according to the United Nations.

The largest displacement began in August 2017, when Myanmar’s armed forces launched an offensive following attacks by the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army insurgent group on about 30 police posts and an army base.

The military crackdown forced hundreds of thousands of Rohingya to flee into Bangladesh. Refugees described mass killings, gang rapes, torture and the burning of hundreds of villages, according to Human Rights Watch.

Myanmar’s government denied the allegations, saying its forces were targeting militants.

WHAT IS THE ICJ CASE AGAINST MYANMAR?

In 2019, Gambia filed a case at the International Court of Justice (ICJ), also known as the World Court, backed by the 57-member Organisation of Islamic Cooperation, alleging that Myanmar’s 2017 military offensive in Rakhine State amounted to genocide.

The ICJ judgments are final and binding, but the court has limited means of enforcement and cannot convict individuals or issue arrest warrants.

In 2019 preliminary hearings in the ICJ case, Myanmar’s then leader, Aung San Suu Kyi, rejected Gambia’s accusations of genocide as “incomplete and misleading”.

The ICJ in January 2020 ordered Myanmar to take urgent measures to protect Rohingya people remaining in the country, including preventing possible genocidal acts and preserving evidence.

WHAT IS THE SITUATION IN RAKHINE?

Myanmar’s military, led by Min Aung Hlaing, seized power in February 2021. The overthrow of Aung San Suu Kyi’s elected government triggered a nationwide civil war that has killed an estimated 100,000 people and displaced more than 3.5 million.

As conflict spread, renewed fighting between Myanmar’s military junta and the Arakan Army rebel group broke out in Rakhine State in November 2023, forcing more Rohingya civilians to flee to neighbouring Bangladesh.

The minority group has also faced attacks by the Arakan Army, which set alight swathes of the Rohingya settlement of Buthidaung in May 2024, Reuters has reported.

WHY CAN’T THE ROHINGYA RETURN?

As conflict rages on in Rakhine, conditions for the safe return of Rohingya refugees do not currently exist, according to aid groups.

Myanmar said in August that it had verified 308,797 people living in displacement camps in Bangladesh as former residents of Rakhine State, but repatriation would begin only when security conditions in Rakhine improve.

Some Rohingya refugees say they are not willing to go back without full rights, dignity, and citizenship.

Myanmar’s government has long seen the Rohingya as illegal migrants from neighbouring Bangladesh and denied them citizenship, even though Rohingya families have lived in Myanmar for generations.

Earlier repatriation plans in 2018 and 2019 resulted in no returns.

(Reporting by Reuters staff; Editing by Raju Gopalakrishnan)

item.description: "Measures will be taken against anyone who cooperates with UAE in the invasion against Somalia," Information Minister Abdifatah Kasim Mohamud said in a broadcast on the state-run news agency on Thursday (Nov 19).

Somalia orders UAE ambassador to leave, citing 'invasion'

"Measures will be taken against anyone who cooperates with UAE in the invasion against Somalia," Information Minister Abdifatah Kasim Mohamud said in a broadcast on the state-run news agency on Thursday (Nov 19).

Soldiers with their armored vehicles near a checkpoint in Mogadishu. The UAE has helped fund and train Somalia's military and backed ports and other commercial ventures. (AP Photo/Farah Abdi Warsameh, File)

FAST

MOGADISHU: Somalia ordered the United Arab Emirates ambassador on Thursday (Nov 19) to leave the country within 72 hours and withdrew its own envoy from Abu Dhabi, accusing the Emirates of unspecified violations of Somalia's sovereignty that amounted to an "open invasion". "Measures will be taken against anyone who cooperates with UAE in the invasion against Somalia," Information Minister Abdifatah Kasim Mohamud said in a broadcast on the state-run news agency. "All Somalis are urged to defend their country and unite against the open invasion of the UAE against the sovereignty, security, land and unity of Somalis." The minister did not elaborate on the actions the UAE had taken that had provoked Somalia's response.

In a speech on Tuesday, Somalia's President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud had accused the UAE of giving economic and political support to some regional Somali governments to oppose the federal government. There was no immediate response from the UAE foreign ministry. The UAE, which has helped fund and train Somalia's military in the past and has backed ports and other commercial ventures there, has long denied meddling in the country's affairs.

Related:

UAE investigators say flydubai co-pilot was planning 'terrorist act'

In January, Somalia said it had ended all agreements with the UAE, including port deals and defence and security cooperation, accusing the UAE of undermining its national sovereignty. Three self-governing Somali regions that have close relations with the United Arab Emirates dismissed that move at the time. The UAE has long leveraged its wealth to expand its influence across the Horn of Africa, using a mix of economic, military and diplomatic clout to assert regional power. For decades Somalia's federal government has had only limited authority across the country, and has failed to defeat Islamist militants, despite years of international support, including African peacekeepers and US air strikes. The UAE trained hundreds of Somali troops from 2014 to 2018, and still covers salaries and provides logistics for around 3,400 Somali military police and special forces troops in and around the capital, according to senior Somali sources. It has also forged bonds directly with regional governments, committing hundreds of millions of dollars to ports and military infrastructure on the coast along global shipping routes.

Source: Reuters/ht

West presses Iran at IAEA to let inspections resume at bombed nuclear sites

Reuters

19 November, 2026 06:30 pm IST

Follow Us:

-->

Facebook

X

LinkedIn

WhatsApp

Email

Copy Link

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Stay updated with ThePrint:

Preferred Source

Google Discover

-->

By Francois Murphy VIENNA, Nov 19 (Reuters) – The United States, Britain, France and Germany jointly pressed Tehran at a meeting of the UN atomic watchdog’s board on Thursday to let inspectors return to its nuclear sites bombed by the US and Israel last year, accusing Tehran of “stonewalling”.

Iran has not granted the International Atomic Energy Agency access to those nuclear facilities since the military strikes against them in June 2025.

While the strikes destroyed or badly damaged Iran’s three uranium-enrichment plants known to have been operational at the time, Tehran has not said what happened to its stock of highly enriched uranium, which included material close to weapons grade and remains unaccounted for.

Show Full Article

“It should be of concern to all Members of this Board that for a year and a half, the Agency has lost continuity of knowledge regarding Iran’s previously verified stockpile of high-enriched uranium,” the four Western powers said in a joint statement to the IAEA’s 35-nation Board of Governors.

The board is holding a quarterly meeting this week. IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi informed it that the only inspections in the last quarter were at the undamaged Bushehr nuclear power plant.

“The DG has repeatedly made clear that there is no current technical reason preventing the Agency from accessing the affected nuclear facilities and that inspectors have been ready to return for a long time now,” the four countries said.

“It is up to Iran to seize this opportunity, change course, and address the international community’s long-standing concerns regarding its nuclear program,” they added, referring to “Iran’s stonewalling strategy”.

The US and Israel have not launched major strikes on Iranian nuclear sites since their 12-day campaign last year, but the US has been at war with Iran for nine months and speculation about fresh strikes is mounting while talks on a negotiated solution are deadlocked.

Iran says the US and Israeli attacks caused the current standoff over inspections.

“The root causes of the impossibility of normal safeguards implementation in Iran are the acts of aggression and the continuing threats of renewed attacks at the highest political level of the United States and the Israeli regime against Iran,” Iran said in a statement sent to member states on Wednesday.

It also cited the current US offer of a reward of up to $20 million for information on Iran’s nuclear programme.

“There is no … solid guarantee that acquired information (from inspections), that the US as a member of the Board will inevitably be informed of, would not be used for further attacks,” it added.

(Reporting by Francois Murphy; Editing by Hugh Lawson)

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 19 : The dollar eased against most major peers on Thursday as its recent rally lost momentum ahead of AI company Anthropic's market debut, seen as a key test of appetite for riskier assets and broader market sentiment. The dollar rally started on November 10 when hotter-than-expected US inflation data bolstered expectations that the US Federal Reserve would tighten its policy.  Fed Governor Christopher Waller called for a more aggressive response to inflation, while minutes of the central bank's October 27 to 28 meeting showed policymakers increasingly concerned that additional tightening might be needed.  "The dollar has had a good run here ... I think a lot of good news is priced into the dollar at this point," Shaun Osborne, chief currency strategist at Scotiabank, said.

"Dollar bulls are going to need more conviction or more bullish news to drive dollar gains in the short run here," said Osborne, who pegged some of the dollar's softer tone to a pickup in risk sentiment ahead of the Anthropic IPO. Nasdaq futures rose on Thursday after Anthropic priced its IPO above the marketed range, bolstering expectations for a strong debut and reviving sentiment around AI stocks. The dollar index this week reached its highest level since April 2, 2025, when US President Donald Trump revealed a sweeping tariff package, triggering a selloff in US assets.  It was last down 0.2 per cent at 103.65, after reaching 103.97. The euro rose 0.2 per cent to $1.1002. Barclays analysts said fiscal stimulus and strong AI-related capital spending point to a resilient US economy, a wider output gap and higher-for-longer interest rates, all supportive of dollar strength. The dollar's gains have come despite a selloff in technology shares. A Deutsche Bank tracker following more than 100 foreign-domiciled exchange-traded funds showed large dip-buying of US stocks by foreigners over the last two weeks, the biggest buying spree so far this year. Such a move reinforces the view that the dollar has been supported by investor flows into US equities. YEN SLIPS AS SAFE-HAVEN FLOWS FADE The dollar was up 0.4 per cent to 159.905 yen, snapping a four-day losing streak. Analysts said that a further selloff in AI-linked assets could support the yen through safe-haven buying and repatriation flows, with the impact likely to be more pronounced against other currencies than against the dollar. The risk-sensitive Aussie was about flat on the day after hitting a fresh 11-month low earlier in the session. Australia's employment fell for a second straight month in October and the jobless rate climbed to a five-year high, bolstering the view that rates have likely peaked. "The sharp hawkish repricing of Fed rate hike expectations is contributing (to) the weakness in commodity prices and related currencies," said Lee Hardman, senior currency analyst at MUFG. UBS brought forward its forecast for the first Reserve Bank of Australia rate cut to August next year from November, and extended the easing cycle to three cuts from two, citing elevated inflation and a deterioration in the labour and housing markets. Sterling pulled back from a 20-month high against the euro, though investors remained upbeat about the UK interest rate outlook and wary of headwinds facing the single currency ahead of key elections across Europe in 2027. The pound rose 0.1 per cent against the dollar to $1.3162. In cryptocurrency markets, bitcoin rose 2.5 per cent to $63,870, pulling away from the four-month low of $62,026 touched on Sunday, aided by stronger risk appetite.

Source: Reuters

item.description: LONDON, Nov 19 : The British government has issued an order to bypass encryption to access customer data held by Apple, a London tribunal confirmed on Thursday, rejecting an argument that revealing the order's existence could damage national security.The government had said that it could not comment on the ex

item.content:encoded:

UK tribunal confirms government order demanding access to Apple data

FILE PHOTO: The Apple Inc logo is seen at the entrance to the Apple store in Brussels, Belgium November 28, 2022. REUTERS/Yves Herman/=/File Photo

19 Nov 2026 08:30PM (Updated: 19 Nov 2026 10:51PM)

FAST

LONDON, Nov 19 : The British government has issued an order to bypass encryption to access customer data held by Apple, a London tribunal confirmed on Thursday, rejecting an argument that revealing the order's existence could damage national security. The government had said that it could not comment on the existence of the order, known as a technical capability notice, because it operated a policy of "neither confirm nor deny" on security matters. However, the Investigatory Powers Tribunal said the amount of information already in the public domain meant that confirming the order would do little, if any, damage. In response to the ruling, the British government said the right to privacy was crucial but should not come at the expense of public safety.

"Apple has been helping the police and intelligence agencies pursue criminals and bring them to justice for several years, in accordance with the law," a government spokesperson said in a statement. "This technical capability notice simply requires that they maintain the ability to do so." FIRST ORDER DROPPED AFTER US INTERVENTION In January last year, Britain issued an initial notice for what is known as a back door to allow it access to encrypted cloud backups of data of US and British citizens. That demand was dropped following months of negotiations with US President Donald Trump's administration, but in July Britain issued a second notice that applied just to Apple's UK customers. Apple launched a renewed challenge against the government at the tribunal, a specialist court, but had been unable to give public details on why because of legal restrictions. Civil rights groups and Apple had told the tribunal at a hearing in September the British government's "neither confirm nor deny" policy was an affront to open justice and prevented meaningful public discussion. The tribunal said in its ruling that the government "has not established that it would be damaging to national security to reveal in these proceedings, as is the case, that (Britain's interior ministry) has given Apple a technical capability notice." The tribunal said it had also handed down private judgments which could not be disclosed without "damaging the public interest". Thursday's ruling was merely to consider whether the notice could be publicly acknowledged and a trial to decide the substance of the case is not expected until next year. "Decisions affecting the safety of the British public must be made by democratically elected governments and independent judges, not in the boardrooms of technology companies," the government spokesperson said. UK SAID CONFIRMATION WAS RISKY The government's lawyer had argued abandoning the "neither confirm nor deny" stance posed a national security risk and would "provide material assistance to hostile actors". However, lawyers for campaign groups Privacy International and Liberty said the refusal to confirm the order's existence had become "farcical" after US politicians and officials publicly referred to the original order and unidentified UK government sources confirmed it. Akiko Hart, director of Liberty, said the ruling was "a victory for transparency". "The public deserve to know when the government's actions undermine their privacy and safety," Hart said in a statement. The tribunal said that "the extent to which, if at all, the details of the government's notice could be disclosed without damaging national security or the public interest" would be dealt with at later hearings.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米中ロ首脳会談、「平和宣言」で合意 核戦争回避を再確認
item.description:
Jarrett Renshaw Trevor Hunnicutt
[深セン（中国） １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jarrett Renshaw　Trevor Hunnicutt

[深セン（中国） １９日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席、トランプ米大統領、ロシアのプーチン大統領は１９日、初の３者会談で「平和宣言」に合意、核戦争は決して起こしてはならないと再確認した。中国とロシアが明らかにした。

３首脳は宣言で、国連改革を進め、全ての国への石油製品の供給を増やすとともに、国際裁判所での国家当局者の免責特権擁護も表明した。

宣言は中国国営の新華社通信とロシア大統領府が公表した。３首脳はいずれも会談直後に声明を発表せず、トランプ氏は帰国の途に就いた。

舞台となった麒麟山荘で３首脳は円卓を囲み会談した。トランプ氏は会談冒頭、「われわれはまさに歴史をつくっている。３人で話し合うべきことは数多くある」と表明。プーチン氏は、３カ国には「ウクライナ紛争を含め、地域紛争の解決において数多くの共通の利益がある」と述べた。

トランプ氏やプーチン氏とは異なり習氏はウクライナには言及せず、「歴史が教えているのは、大国が調和し共存すれば世界は平和になり、大国が衝突すれば世界は混乱に陥るということだ」と述べた。

３カ国にはウクライナ、イラン、核兵器、貿易を巡って深い隔たりがあり、成果が得られるか疑問が残る。

トランプ氏は３者会談に先立ち、習氏、プーチン氏と個別に会談した。

麒麟山荘は、外交上重要な会合の場として長い歴史を持つ。過去には北朝鮮の故金正日総書記、習氏の父、習仲勲氏、ダライ・ラマの特使らが訪れている。

item.title: トランプ政権高官、ベネズエラへのガイアナ領土割譲提案＝関係筋
item.description:
Sarah Kinosian Gram Slattery Humeyra Pamuk
[カラカス／ワシントン １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sarah Kinosian　Gram Slattery　Humeyra Pamuk

[カラカス／ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権高官が南米ガイアナに対し、領土の一部を隣国ベネズエラに割譲することを検討するよう持ちかけていたことが分かった。関係筋３人が明らかにした。この発言は産油国であるガイアナの当局者を驚かせ、米国は両国の国境に関する自国の政策は変わっていないとガイアナ側に保証せざるを得なくなったという。

ベネズエラは長年、ガイアナにある金、ダイヤモンド、ボーキサイトが豊富なエセキボ地域の領有権を主張してきたが、米国をはじめとする世界のほぼ全ての国はガイアナ領と認めている。

関係筋の１人によると、国務省で政策担当責任者を務めていたジェレミー・ルーウィン氏（１０月末に辞任）は９月にワシントンで行われた会談で、ガイアナのロバート・パサード外務長官に対し、ベネズエラのロドリゲス暫定大統領との領土問題に関する協議を仲介できると述べた。

他の２人の関係筋によると、ルーウィン氏はエセキボ地域をベネズエラが部分的に統治する可能性を示唆した。

ルーウィン氏はロイターとのインタビューで、ガイアナとベネズエラの領土紛争に関して、両国と「予備的な」協議を行ったと明らかにした。同氏によると、これらの協議は、ロドリゲス氏が５月にトランプ米大統領に書簡を送り、ガイアナとの領土問題に関する直接協議を促進するため、米国の仲介を求めた後に実施された。

７月にカラカスで行われた会談でロドリゲス氏からもこの問題を直接提起されたという。ルーウィン氏は、これらのやりとりはホワイトハウスによって完全に指示され、承認されたものだったと付け加えた。

このエピソードは、トランプ政権とロドリゲス暫定政権の関係が深まっていることを浮き彫りにしている。

一方、関係筋によると、ガイアナでこの出来事はエセキボ地域の地位は交渉の余地がないと繰り返し述べてきた当局者を驚かせた。

国務省当局者はコメント要請に対し、電子メールで「（同省は）外部の関係者から日々さまざまなアイデアや政策案を提示されている」ものの、ベネズエラとガイアナの国境問題に関する立場は変わっていないと回答した。

ホワイトハウスは、エセキボ地域の将来に関する協議を指示したかどうか、あるいはロドリゲス氏から書簡を受け取ったかどうかについては言及せず、国務省に問い合わせるよう求めた。

米国とベネズエラ間の関係に詳しい関係者によると、ルーウィン氏はホワイトハウスからこの問題について指示を受けていたという。

ガイアナ政府とベネズエラ政府はコメント要請に応じなかった。

item.title: 独成長率は第4四半期に加速、年明けインフレ上昇へ 連銀見通し
item.description: [フランクフルト １９日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）は１９日公表した月報で、ドイツの経済成長は第４・四...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
独成長率は第4四半期に加速、年明けインフレ上昇へ　連銀見通し 11/19 20:27 配信

フランクフルトの高層ビル街、10月11日撮影 REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach（ロイター） [フランクフルト １９日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）は１９日公表した月報で、ドイツの経済成長は第４・四半期に加速する見通しだが、インフレも特に年明け以降に加速する可能性が高いと指摘した。

世界第３位の経済大国であるドイツは２６年、エネルギー価格高騰が経済に大きな打撃を与えるとの予想に反し、堅調な輸出需要と財政刺激策に支えられ、予想外に力強い成長を遂げている。

連銀によると、過去に成長の原動力だった国内消費は低迷が続くが、３年間の停滞に終止符を打った比較的堅調な景気は、今後数カ月も続く可能性が高い。「拡張的な財政政策が引き続き景気を押し上げている」とし、「産業界は国内需要の増加と世界貿易の拡大の恩恵を受けている」と説明した。

主要な予測機関の大半は現在、２６年通年のドイツの成長率が、２５年の０．３％から１％を十分に上回る水準に高まると見込んでいる。

ただ、連銀は「２７年初めにはインフレ率が急上昇すると予想される」と指摘した。

燃料補助金などの政府措置の終了だけで、インフレ率は約０．５％ポイント押し上げられる可能性がある。連銀はまた、ガス価格が上昇し、エネルギーコスト増加が他の財やサービスの価格に波及すると予想している。

１０月のインフレ率は２．９％と、ユーロ圏内で低水準だった。２７年以降の急上昇は、ユーロ圏全体のインフレ率も押し上げると見込まれている。

item.title: イスラエル軍、ガザで停戦ライン越えた戦車作戦終了
item.description:
Nidal al-Mughrabi
[カイロ １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nidal al-Mughrabi

[カイロ １９日 ロイター] - イスラエル軍は１９日、ガザ地区中部で、イスラム組織ハマスのものとみられるトンネルを破壊するための戦車部隊による作戦を終えたと発表した。

フェイスブックにガザ住民に向けたメッセージを投稿し、部隊が同地域での「ハマスのインフラを対象とした活動」を終了したと述べた。ガザを南北に貫く幹線道路も通行が再開されたとした。

１８日にはイスラエル軍の戦車が、イスラエルとハマスの支配地域の境界を示すイエローラインを越えた。境界線を越えて奥深くまで進攻する作戦を公表したのは、２０２５年１０月の停戦以降初めてだった。イエローライン西側にあり部隊に脅威を与えているとするトンネルを破壊するため、「標的を絞った作戦行動」を開始したと説明していた。

軍の攻撃再開を恐れたパレスチナ人の家族らは避難した。ハマスが運営するガザ政府の報道部門によると、１８日にこの地域を離れた人は約６０００人に上った。

住民らは１９日、散発的な銃声が聞こえるなど幹線道路は依然として危険で、車両も人も近づけないと語った。

item.description: The stock opened at US$111.50, 34 per cent above its US$83 IPO price, and was last trading at US$108.72.

item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Anthropic hits US$2 trillion in Nasdaq debut, tops SpaceX's June listing

The stock opened at US$111.50, 34 per cent above its US$83 IPO price, and was last trading at US$108.72.

CEO of Anthropic Dario Amodei, President and co-founder of Anthropic Daniela Amodei, Co-Founder and Chief Science Officer of Anthropic Jared Kaplan, Co-Founder and Head of Public Benefit of Anthropic Jack Clark celebrate as Anthropic, PBC (ANT) holds their initial public offering (IPO) at the NASDAQ MarketSite in New York City, US, Nov 19, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Brendan McDermid)

FAST

NEW YORK: Anthropic's market value hit US$2 trillion in its Nasdaq debut on Thursday (Nov 19), soaring past SpaceX's massive June launch as investors rushed to buy shares of the world's first publicly traded frontier AI company. The stock opened at US$111.5, 34 per cent higher than the IPO price of US$83. It was last trading at US$108.72. The Claude chatbot maker's IPO, together with Tuesday's earnings report by AI poster child Nvidia, signals the industry has nominally passed the two big tests facing it this week. Strong demand for Anthropic shares amid a broader tech selloff offers hope to a sector where euphoria has somewhat cooled in recent weeks.

"I've looked at this whole week as a referendum on AI. Nvidia gave us a read on the buildout, and Anthropic is about to give us a read on investor appetite for the next generation of AI companies," Jake Behan, head of capital markets at Direxion, said before the Anthropic debut. AI technology has boosted economic growth, sparked doomsday warnings and arguably helped usher in a data-centre-sceptic Democratic tsunami in the US midterm elections. Investors who once embraced the boom have turned skeptical in recent weeks over concerns that the enormous spending needed to build out the sector and the mounting debt loads may not be justified by the eventual returns. Anthropic, too, has signalled it may tap debt markets. "At some point in the future we're hoping to be investment grade, and debt is an instrument that we have available to us, and we'd like to use at some point in the future," CEO Dario Amodei told CNBC in an interview.

CEO of Anthropic Dario Amodei and President and co-founder of Anthropic Daniela Amodei celebrate as Anthropic, PBC (ANT) holds their initial public offering (IPO) at the NASDAQ MarketSite in New York City, US, Nov 19, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Brendan McDermid)

AN INDUSTRY BENCHMARK As the first frontier AI company to go public, Anthropic is poised to become the sector's benchmark, with its arch-rival OpenAI reportedly eyeing a 2027 listing. The company sold 980 million shares at US$83 each, pricing the IPO above its initial range of US$70 to US$78 set when it launched the road show. Its IPO proceeds could climb to as much as US$93.5 billion if underwriters fully exercise their option to purchase additional shares. Currently, the figure sits at over US$107 billion, including the additional US$26 billion raised through a private placement. AMD, Broadcom, Alphabet's Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC were the investors in the private placement. "Some of the demand may simply reflect investors not wanting to miss out on the rare opportunity to gain exposure to a leading AI company, even if its long-term profitability remains uncertain," IPOX associate Lukas Muehlbauer said. London-based index rebalance analytics firm Intropic estimates passive demand from index-tracking funds will account for purchase of up to 30 per cent of Anthropic's shares offered by the end of the year. Anthropic will also join the trillion-dollar club stacked with behemoths such as Microsoft, Apple and Nvidia. The blockbuster deal is going to earn the underwriters, led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, a US$550 million fee, a regulatory filing showed.

BIG PAYDAY FOR CO-FOUNDERS Although shares can be volatile in the days following a listing, Anthropic's IPO is set to create thousands of paper millionaires and a handful of billionaires. Based on the IPO price, CEO Amodei and his six co-founders, who together own about 10 per cent of the company, had stakes valued at nearly US$150 billion combined, according to a Reuters calculation based on details in the filing. More broadly, the listing is expected to create a wave of new wealth across the AI sector, rewarding everyone from early researchers and engineers to administrative staff.

Related:

'Business as usual': Nvidia's Kress passes first test as board slams door on Huang

Commentary: Anthropic’s mega IPO is coming. Don’t let hype drive your investment decisions

JUSTIFYING THE PRICE TAG Debate has intensified across global markets in recent months over whether the AI boom is veering into bubble territory, with economists, CEOs and political leaders split over its sustainability. Much of the scrutiny has focused on circular financing arrangements. A complicated web of deals between AI companies, chipmakers, cloud providers and investors has raised questions over how much of the industry's growth is being fueled by money circulating within the same ecosystem. Anthropic's breakneck growth has so far defied these concerns, but some investors have said they may wait for the initial euphoria to subside before buying. "Anthropic is a one-trick pony. People compare it with Amazon because even Amazon lost money for several years, but Anthropic won't have that luxury," said Bill Gunderson, partner at GCG Advisory Partners. "They've got to get to profitability soon." Anthropic has nearly US$900 billion in computing commitments with partners including Amazon and Alphabet's Google, underscoring how its rapid growth hinges on securing vast amounts of future computing capacity, some of which relies on financing beyond the company's control. Investors will be watching Anthropic's debut and subsequent trading closely, with analysts expecting the stock to emerge as a proxy for the broader AI trade. The company will also need to balance growth with calls to slow the development of advanced AI models. Anthropic warned in its IPO prospectus that AI could behave unpredictably and advance faster than oversight mechanisms.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: バングラデシュで暴力再燃、ハシナ氏支持者が全国的な封鎖行動
item.description: [ダッカ １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ダッカ １９日 ロイター] - バングラデシュで１９日、ハシナ前首相の支持者が全国的な封鎖行動を実施し、新たな暴力事件が発生した。情勢が再び不安定化するとの懸念が高まっている。

これとは別に、賃上げを求める縫製労働者の抗議行動も一部の県で続いた。数百人の労働者が首都ダッカに通じる主要幹線道路を封鎖し、工場は閉鎖に追い込まれた。

ハシナ氏は２０２４年８月、学生らによるデモを受けて国外に逃れ、現在は隣国インドで亡命生活を送っている。同氏が１２月に帰国する意向を示してから、緊張が高まっている。

ハシナ氏の帰国に必要な新しい旅券（パスポート）と身分証明書の発行申請を政府が拒否したことを受け、同氏が率いるアワミ連盟は１週間にわたって抗議活動や集会を展開。その締めくくりとして、１９日に全国的な封鎖行動を呼びかけた。

警察によると、ダッカと南東部チッタゴンを結ぶ幹線道路でバス１台とトラック１台が放火された。バスの乗客は避難して無事だった。

バングラデシュ国境警備隊の報道官によると、暴力を防ぐため、ハシナ氏の支持者が多いとされるゴパルガンジとファリドプルを含む７県に９７個小隊を展開した。

＜ダッカで１０７人逮捕＞

警察の報道官によると、ダッカでは過去２４時間に、アワミ連盟やその関連組織とのつながりが疑われる１０７人を逮捕した。ナヒド元教育相も含まれる。

警察によると、チッタゴンで１８日深夜、ユヌス元暫定政権最高顧問の先祖代々の家が放火された。ハシナ氏の失脚後にバングラデシュを統治したユヌス氏とその政権は、ハシナ氏の支持者から敵視されてきた。

ラーマン政権は国外にいるアワミ連盟の指導者らが暴力をあおっていると非難し、対処すると表明した。ラーマン首相は１８日に議会で「われわれがこの国を自立したバングラデシュへと変えようとしているまさにこの時、失脚し、逃亡し、追放されたファシスト勢力がバングラデシュに対する陰謀を企て始めた」と述べた。

item.title: 韓国最高裁、戒厳令巡り韓悳洙元首相の審理差し戻し 一部判決覆す
item.description:
Heejin Kim Joyce Lee
[ソウル １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Heejin Kim　Joyce Lee

[ソウル １９日 ロイター] - 韓国最高裁は１９日、２年前の「非常戒厳」宣言に関与したとして懲役１５年の判決を受けた韓悳洙元首相（７７）について、一部の判決を覆し、審理を高裁に差し戻した。

韓被告が戒厳令発令に正当性を与える意図で閣議を手配したとする二審の認定に異議を唱えた。ただ、戒厳令発令後、同被告が関連文書への閣僚の署名を求めるなどの行動を通じて「憲法秩序を転覆させる」意図を示したとする二審の判断については同意した。

特別検察チームは声明で、裁判所の判決を尊重すると述べた。

韓被告は、偽証罪の１件を除く全ての罪状を否認している。

最高裁はまた、尹錫悦前大統領の妻で、株式取引不正や、韓国の統一教会からの賄賂受領で有罪判決を受けていた金建希被告に対する懲役４年の判決を支持した。
